newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay adds three new codeshare destinations in UK.
newsitem.headline: Cathay adds three new codeshare destinations in UK.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways is adding codeshare flights from London to three new UK destinations, the airline said in a statement.
From February 1, Cathay will offer codeshare flights with British Midland to Edinburgh, Belfast and Teesside. The Hong Kong carrier already offers codeshare flights with British Midland to Glasgow.
The departures are timed to connect conveniently with Cathay's Hong Kong to London flight CX251 and CX250 return to Hong Kong.
Duncan Pring, Cathay's route general manager Europe, said the new codeshares will mean much more convenient connections for travellers from Hong Kong.

"These are the best connections available from Hong Kong. Passengers for these destinations can leave Hong Kong in the evening and be at their destination in the UK mid morning the next day," Pring said in the statement. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
